decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL03, dated 17.12.2014, received 03/02/2015; Planning Statement, let.001.MP.S.10460086, dated 28 January 2015, received 03/02/2015; E6520 Q5, dated 17/09/2014, received 10/03/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Any noise emanating from the hereby approved generator shall not exceed 10dB below background noise levels (measured as LA90) for the area, measured at the boundary for the site.  Any low frequency noise from the generator shall not be perceptible in any nearby residential property.
description: Erection of a standby generator at Jubilee Mail Centre
